records.title: 1906 San Francisco Earthquake

provenance.source_name: U.S. Geological Survey Earthquake Hazards Program

rights.redistribution_notes: USGS explains that works produced wholly by U.S. Government employees are public domain in the United States; attribution is retained as provenance.

reliability.source_precision: Preferred origin time stated to one millisecond; coordinates retained to 0.001 degree; depth stated to 0.1 km.
reliability.notes: The event page also exposes alternate historical origins; this record deliberately uses its highest-weight preferred official origin.

records.ethical_notes: Historical natural disaster. Use factual language and avoid entertainment framing or victim-level personal data.

chart_readiness.reason: The preferred USGS origin states an exact UTC instant and epicentral coordinates.

event_metadata.notes: The 11.7 km hypocentral depth is event metadata. Chart calculation uses surface elevation, not negative depth.
